title: Double bit-flip is the identity
statement: Let $\omega$ be a sample of the hard distribution, recording a special coordinate $T$, Alice's and Bob's bits $x_T, y_T$ at that coordinate, and an assignment of the remaining coordinates. Toggling Alice's special-coordinate bit twice — that is, applying to $\omega$ the map that negates $x_T$ while leaving $T$, $y_T$, and the other coordinates unchanged, and then applying that same map again — recovers $\omega$ exactly.
hypotheses_covered: ω is a sample of the hard distribution (HardSample)
